 Voters casting absentee ballots Thursday saw a slight delay in obtaining their ballots after a large internet outage prompted election workers to verify voter registration status a alternate way. Pioneer photo by Sierra Ferguson 
 SPEARFISH — A mass internet outage in the Blue Peak user area required election workers at Hudson Hall in Spearfish to verify voters a slightly different way Thursday afternoon. They picked up the phone and called the office in Deadwood.
 The outage lasted for only 7 minutes, but it had some voters question how the situation would be handled.
